Chemical Science and Engineering
The doctoral program at Chemical Science and Engineering has three research areas: Fibre and Polymer Science, Chemistry and Chemical Engineering.
The programme is extensive and covers a wide range of important issues, such as improvement of solar cells, development of environmental friendly and efficient energy processes, design and manufacturing of new polymers for medical application.
If you are interested in becoming a PhD student, primarily contact the department or division where you want to study.
